description: Delayed market quotes collected from Yahoo Finance: 32 stock market index levels, US index futures, front-month commodity futures and US dollar exchange rates. Each quote carries its market time (asOf, UTC), unit, market and source URL; change is against the previous session close. Quotes can be delayed by 15 minutes or more. Official daily reference rates (ECB, central banks, treasuries) are separate: use get_series_data.

group.description: indices: stock index levels; futures: US index futures; commodities: front-month commodity futures; fx: US dollar exchange rates; all (default).

ids.description: Exact quote IDs, for example YF.IDX.USA (S&P 500), YF.IDX.JPN (Nikkei 225), YF.BRENT or YF.FX.EUR. Narrows the group.

name: get_market_quotes
